observations: Independent reserve archive front was visually compared with this same current design. Shared reviewed geometry from team_8de8bdc8ff2954d5f251-away-r002.json; reserve evidence/identity stays separate. Deep teal shirt with dense tiny turquoise open-diamond knit across front and sleeves, pale shoulder tapes and pale-edged dark neckline. Corrected sleeve ends are dark teal, not the pale cuff bands of the earlier draft. The reserve source is a darker navy recreation; the print geometry is independently verified, with colors estimated from that source. Independent current variant front inspected. All sponsors, manufacturer marks, club crests and lettering removed. Colors are estimates; original PNG fabric/alpha and existing round collar are preserved.
omitted: Emblems, logos, sponsors and lettering. Original PNG collar construction retained.
